semantic_range: friend; brother or sister; lover; bond-partner; one held as part of oneself
why_it_resists_translation: Fuses three relationships English keeps apart, and any one can be meant alone or all together. Carries a sacred, near-metaphysical weight that 'friend' or 'soulmate' flattens.
earth_parallels: Greek philia, storge and eros as one word; Irish anam cara 'soul friend'; Sanskrit sakhā; Hebrew re'a (companion, neighbor, lover)
notes: Source: Roddenberry's TMP novelization footnote, not on screen. Hypothesis to test: the t' is the old 'of / belonging to' marker, so t'hy'la = 'one of the hy'la', a bonded pair or circle.

semantic_range: living spirit; memory; consciousness; the transferable self
why_it_resists_translation: A physically transferable self with no English equivalent: neither soul (not supernatural) nor memory (more than data).
earth_parallels: Egyptian ka (life-double, also a sound echo); Greek psyche; Hindu jiva
notes: Canon. Behaves as a concrete noun: it can be carried, stored in an ark, fused back.

semantic_range: logic; reality-truth; things as they are; right relation to reality
why_it_resists_translation: English 'logic' names a method; cthia names reality itself and the duty to treat it truthfully.
earth_parallels: Sanskrit ṛta (cosmic order and truth); Greek logos; Chinese dao
notes: Duane, Spock's World. Standard spelling kthia.

semantic_range: passion's mastery; emotional self-command; disciplined feeling
why_it_resists_translation: Outsiders hear 'suppression'; the word says mastery of emotions that are fully present.
earth_parallels: Stoic enkrateia (self-mastery) and apatheia; Pali sati (mindful attention)

semantic_range: what is, is; acceptance of fact; suchness
why_it_resists_translation: A whole stance in one word: calm acceptance with no resignation or fatalism.
earth_parallels: Zen tathātā 'suchness'; Stoic amor fati; English 'it is what it is'

semantic_range: gut feeling; sensed atmosphere; felt sense of a situation
why_it_resists_translation: Names an intuition Vulcans officially distrust but still have a word for.
earth_parallels: German Bauchgefühl; English 'vibes'

semantic_range: the engulfment; instant overwhelming attraction; love at first sight
why_it_resists_translation: An involuntary, total event rather than a feeling, which English splits across several idioms.
earth_parallels: Italian colpo di fulmine 'thunderbolt'; French coup de foudre

semantic_range: total exposure; being laid bare; embarrassment of the inner self
why_it_resists_translation: Combines exposure and shame in one state with no single English word.
earth_parallels: Japanese haji (shame) in part

semantic_range: one who belittles another's attachment
why_it_resists_translation: Names a person by a specific emotional wrong; English needs a clause.
earth_parallels: None close

semantic_range: lifelong management of emotion; discipline as a way of life
why_it_resists_translation: A practice spanning a whole life, not a single act of control.
earth_parallels: Greek askēsis (training); Pali sati

semantic_range: the known but unspoken higher reality
why_it_resists_translation: Falls under the Rule of Silences: its meaning is partly that it is not discussed.
earth_parallels: Apophatic theology; the unspoken Tetragrammaton

semantic_range: two forms; a whole of two contrasting halves
why_it_resists_translation: An art form and a worldview at once.
earth_parallels: Chinese yin-yang
notes: 1960s fan word (Heydt) later adopted by canon as Vulcan's name.

semantic_range: blood fever; the madness stage of pon farr
why_it_resists_translation: A biological state that is also a ritual stage, with fixed social rules.
earth_parallels: Malay amuk, source of English 'run amok' (and the episode title 'Amok Time')

semantic_range: time of mating; the biological and ritual cycle
why_it_resists_translation: Biology, law and ritual in one term; 'mating season' loses the ritual and the danger.
earth_parallels: None close

semantic_range: purging of all emotion; the final discipline of Gol
why_it_resists_translation: A ritual path and its goal in one word.
earth_parallels: Buddhist nirvana in structure (an extinguishing)

semantic_range: revenge worse than death
why_it_resists_translation: A recognized category of revenge, implying a pre-Surak honor code.
earth_parallels: Corsican vendetta; Albanian gjakmarrja (blood feud)

semantic_range: the ruling passion; honor shown through courtesy; obligation that can require killing
why_it_resists_translation: Honor, courtesy and duty fused, enforced by social face.
earth_parallels: Japanese giri (obligation); Roman dignitas and mos maiorum

semantic_range: structure of harmony
why_it_resists_translation: Joins form and peace in one concept.
earth_parallels: Greek harmonia

era: Classical, kept as intimate speech in Standard
semantic_range: confiding an attraction to a bond-kin; telling a friend that someone is drawn to them; weighing a possible courtship with family before any approach; the confidence itself
why_it_resists_translation: English has 'confide' and 'gossip' but no word that is both, separated only by who is listening. The same whispered sentence is kekru-vrakh among bond-kin and vrakhuth, rumor, anywhere else. It also names the absent third person as part of the act.
earth_parallels: Japanese uchiakeru (to open one's heart in confidence) and kokuhaku (the declaration it precedes); the matchmaker's preliminary talk in many cultures; English 'a word in your ear'
notes: Batch 21. Standard grammar still marks the absent one's feeling with an evidential, so even a heart-whisper says how it knows.

semantic_range: bond-warmth: the other's presence felt through the bond; bond-ache: the pain of long distance; bond-silence: the stillness where a bonded mind is no longer felt, through great distance or death
why_it_resists_translation: English 'miss' describes a feeling about someone. These describe what the bond itself reports, so a Vulcan can say them as evidence, marked with tekh, rather than as emotion. A Standard speaker who would never say 'I missed you' can say 'the bond-silence was long', and the meaning is the same.
earth_parallels: Japanese sabishii (the loneliness of absence) and natsukashii (warmth at a return); Portuguese saudade; the phantom-limb sense of a lost partner described in grief research
notes: Batch 22. Bond-silence after a death is the canon situation of Spock sensing the Intrepid's loss (TOS 'The Immunity Syndrome'), scaled down to one mind.
